title: Infrastructure Engineer III - Network Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You belong to the top echelon of talent in your field. At one of the world's most iconic financial institutions, where infrastructure is of paramount importance, you can play a pivotal role.

  

As an Infrastructure Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Engineering team, you utilize strong knowledge of software, applications, and technical processes within the infrastructure engineering discipline.




**Job responsibilities**

* Applies technical knowledge and problem\-solving methodologies to projects of moderate scope, with a focus on improving the data and systems running at scale, and ensures end to end monitoring of applications
* Resolves most nuances and determines appropriate escalation path
* Executes conventional approaches to build or break down technical problems
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate monitoring and capacity analysis and documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements
* Drives the daily activities supporting the standard capacity process applications
* Partners with application and infrastructure teams to identify potential capacity risks and govern remediation statuses
* Considers upstream/downstream data and systems or technical implications
* Applies reuse\-first, AI\-assisted approaches to identify recurring capacity risks and improve remediation workflows, ensuring changes are validated and aligned to resiliency and security expectations.
* Be accountable for making significant decisions for a project consisting of multiple technologies and applications




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification in infrastructure engineering concepts, plus 3\+ years of applied experience
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities to support infrastructure engineering workflows, with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted recommendations before implementation; escalate when uncertain; ensure outcomes meet resiliency, security, and auditability expectations
* Operating knowledge in one or more infrastructure engineering areas (e.g., software\-defined networks/zero\-touch provisioning, SD\-WAN, fabric switching, Wi‑Fi, network security technologies and practices)
* Proficiency in network infrastructure technologies and relevant programming/scripting languages (e.g., Python, Ansible)
* Broad technical knowledge across multiple domains
* Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and multiple cloud technologies, with the ability to operate in and migrate across public and private clouds

Commitment to developing add  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with wired/wireless LAN/BGP WAN/SD\-WAN and 802\.1x technologies from vendors including Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Fortinet, and Forescout
* Exhibits a growing initiative and the ability to manage assigned tasks efficiently, seeking guidance when needed and showing a willingness to find solutions and contribute to improvements with some supervision
* Demonstrates strong communication skills, conveying ideas and challenges with clarity and precision to support understanding and effective collaboration

**Skills**

#### **Knowledge \& Posting Location**


Plumbing Operation \& maintenance of Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) Water Engineering
#### **Minimum Qualification**


Bachelor of Technology (BTech)Bachelor of Engineering (BE)Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (DME)Diploma in Civil Engineering (DCE)
  
**Job Description**
-------------------


The Site Engineer \- PHE is responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and executing all Public Health Engineering (PHE) works in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules. The role includes managing the installation, testing, and commissioning of water supply systems, domestic water distribution networks, drainage systems, sewage systems, stormwater networks, rainwater harvesting systems, sump and tank installations, pumps, water treatment systems, and associated piping infrastructure. The engineer shall review shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, hydraulic calculations, and construction schedules to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable codes and standards.


Responsibilities include coordinating with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and other disciplines such as Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and Mechanical teams to ensure smooth execution of works. The engineer shall monitor site progress, manage manpower and resources, conduct site inspections, verify installation quality, resolve technical issues, and ensure timely completion of project milestones. Additional duties include preparing quantity requirements, monitoring material deliveries, conducting pressure testing, leak testing, flushing, disinfection, and system commissioning activities. The Site Engineer shall maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, inspection records, testing documentation, and as\-built drawings while ensuring compliance with quality and HSE requirements.


The role also involves supporting authority inspections, assisting in project handover documentation, and ensuring all systems are installed and commissioned in accordance with local regulations and client requirements. Experience in Data Centre, Commercial Building, Industrial, Infrastructure, Healthcare, or Mission Critical Facility projects is preferred. The candidate should possess strong knowledge of potable water systems, drainage networks, plumbing installations, water treatment systems, pump systems, hydraulic principles, testing and commissioning procedures, and relevant standards such as IPC, UPC, IS Codes, and local authority regulations. A Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical/Civil Engineering with 3\+ years of relevant experience is required. Strong technical, planning, coordination, problem\-solving, and communication skills are essential for successful project execution and delivery. Project is HYD123\&124\.
